lessThanTransformation: LCSL/less-than derived source numeric bounds remain in nutrientEvidence; normalized nutrient display/ranking value is null. Ordinary source values are unchanged; absent nutrients remain null.
acceptedNormalizations: Leading/trailing description whitespace is trimmed without product substitution.
US and GRM source codes normalize to United States and grams; original source codes remain available.
limitations: Audits cached official payloads only, not a second independent network retrieval.
Source label/analytical quality, current shelf availability, physical packaging and complete allergen statements are not verified.
The two bounded food searches are not a representative market sample and do not prove the latest product outside these queries.
The old partial-ZIP dataset is rejected and is not the subject of this final audit.
